customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflow env vars, tagged with a `# renovate:` annotation. Actions and setup-* inputs are found by the built-in manager; a hand-rolled download URL is not.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates once they are seven days old

Bluebird Forecast's image tag and chart version are written by its own release jobs, after its CI and release checks pass. A Renovate update would move them on Validate manifests alone, so Renovate leaves them to those jobs.

hevy-trainer-sync's image tag is written by its own release job, once its tests and its image scan pass. Its version tag reaches Docker Hub before that scan, so a Renovate update could move to an image the scan stopped. Renovate leaves it to that job.
llama.cpp tags its CPU image light-b<build>, alongside tags for other variants. Only follow this one, and treat each build as a patch.
